title: Was Jesus Really Born on December 25? The Truth They Don’t Want You to Preach
paragraphs: Was Jesus Really Born on December 25? The Truth They Don’t Want You to Preach

Millions gather every year to celebrate December 25 as the birth of Jesus Christ.
Songs are sung. Sermons are preached. Nativities are staged.
But behind the lights, the gifts, and the nostalgia…
Lurks a dangerous assumption:
Was Jesus really born on December 25?
Or have we sacrificed truth on the altar of tradition?
💭 READER QUESTION:

What if celebrating the wrong date isn’t just a small issue —
But a spiritual distortion that feeds religious deception, hides ancient pagan roots, and mocks the very God we claim to honor?
📖 MAIN VERSE:
📜 John 1:14 (KJV)
“And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us…”

This verse celebrates the Incarnation — the eternal God entering human history.
But the timing of that event was never left to speculation — and Scripture gives us clues.

THE CORE TRUTH — GREEK & HEBREW BREAKDOWN OF THE BIRTH OF CHRIST
🧬 Scriptural Dissection Unlocked | Incarnation Coordinates Unveiling
🔥 The language of the Word pierces the veil of tradition.
✝️ THE WORD "BIRTH" — Greek: γεννάω (gennaō)
Meaning: to be begotten, brought forth, caused to be born

Used in relation to natural birth, but also spiritual and prophetic fulfillments.
🔎 Matthew 1:20 uses gennaō for Jesus being conceived of the Holy Ghost — not on December 25, but at a precise, God-ordained time.
✝️ THE WORD "FLESH" — Greek: σάρξ (sarx)
John 1:14 — “The Word became flesh”
This is not about a date on a Roman calendar — but about God entering time.
The Greek emphasizes a supernatural event, not a man-made holiday.
✝️ THE WORD "APPOINTED TIME" — Hebrew: מוֹעֵד (mo’ed)
Meaning: appointed place or feast, divine appointment

This word connects the birth, death, and resurrection of Christ to the biblical feasts, not pagan festivals.
📖 Leviticus 23:2 — “These are My appointed feasts…”

🔥 The Messiah does not move by human holiday schedules.
He fulfills divine mo’edim — appointed by the Father before the foundations of the world.
🔥 CORE TRUTH UNLOCKED:

Jesus was born — but not on a day created by Rome and baptized by religion.
He came at a mo’ed, not a myth.
The real birthday of Jesus is rooted in prophecy, scripture, and heavenly precision — not December consumerism.

📛 The real issue isn't just when He was born…
It's whether we care about what He actually revealed — or if we prefer the traditions that comfort our culture.

BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF — SCRIPTURE + EARLY CHURCH WRITINGS + VERIFIED SOURCES
📜 HISTORIC EXPOSURE UNLOCKED | TRUTH CODE: ACTIVE
🔥 December 25 may be popular — but popularity never equals truth.
📖 A. SCRIPTURAL TIMING CLUES — WHEN WAS JESUS LIKELY BORN?
Luke 1:5–9 — Zacharias and the Course of Abijah
The priestly schedule (1 Chronicles 24:10) reveals Zacharias served during Sivan (June).
After Elizabeth conceives (Luke 1:24), she hides for 5 months — and Mary is told she’ll conceive in the 6th month (December).

💥 Result: Jesus is likely conceived around December…
…which places His birth around September, during the Feast of Tabernacles (Sukkot).
Luke 2:8 — Shepherds in the Fields
“And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.”
Shepherds in Israel do not stay in the fields in winter (December) due to harsh weather.
This further supports a fall birth, not a winter one.
🧱 B. EARLY CHURCH VIEWPOINTS — NOT UNIFIED ON DECEMBER 25

🗝️ The early church did not universally celebrate December 25 as Jesus’ birthday.
In fact, it wasn’t formally adopted until the 4th century A.D.
📖 Origen (185–254 A.D.)

“Only sinners like Pharaoh and Herod celebrate birthdays.”
🧬 Source: Homilies on Leviticus
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0915.htm
📖 Clement of Alexandria (c. 150–215 A.D.)

Listed several possible birthdates based on scholarly interpretation — but never mentioned December 25.
🔗 https://www.ccel.org/ccel/schaff/anf02.vi.iv.iii.xxii.html
🕷️ C. DECEMBER 25 — ORIGINS IN PAGANISM, NOT PROPHECY
The Roman celebration of Sol Invictus ("Unconquered Sun") was held on December 25, marking the winter solstice.
Emperor Aurelian declared it an official Roman holiday in 274 A.D.
Later, church leaders “Christianized” the date to appease the empire.
📖 Encyclopedia Britannica confirms:

“The church in Rome began celebrating Christmas on December 25 in the 4th century, possibly to coincide with pagan festivals.”
🔗 https://www.britannica.com/topic/Christmas-holiday
🔥 SUMMARY:
Jesus was likely born during Sukkot (Feast of Tabernacles) — around late September.
December 25 is a man-made adaptation, not a Spirit-revealed appointment.
True worship must be rooted in truth, not tradition or syncretism.

OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS — THE BIRTH OF CHRIST AND THE FEASTS OF ISRAEL
📖 🔓 SCROLL ALIGNMENT COMPLETE | PROPHETIC CLOCKS SYNCHRONIZED
🔥 Jesus didn’t just appear — He fulfilled prophetic precision timed from the Old Covenant.
✡️ THE MESSIAH AND THE MO’EDIM — DIVINE APPOINTMENTS

God’s calendar is never random.
The Old Testament feasts are not just Jewish history — they are prophetic blueprints of Christ’s redemptive timeline.
📖 Leviticus 23:2 (KJV)
“...concerning the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are My feasts.”

📖 The word for feast in Hebrew: מוֹעֵד (mo’ed) — meaning:
Appointed time, fixed meeting, prophetic rehearsal.
🔥 JESUS was born, crucified, resurrected, and poured out His Spirit — all on specific feasts.
🕊️ BIRTH ALIGNMENT: THE FEAST OF TABERNACLES (SUKKOT)
Occurs around late September to early October
Symbolizes God dwelling among men — which matches John 1:14:
“And the Word became flesh and dwelt [Greek: skēnoō — tabernacled] among us…”

🔥 Jesus likely born during Sukkot, not Saturnalia.
His birth was a fulfillment, not a festivity.
🔥 SYMBOLISM OF THE FEAST OF TABERNACLES:
Temporary shelters (sukkot) — Represented the temporary human body Christ would take on.
Rejoicing and light — Matching the angelic celebration and the “Light of the World” arriving.

Water libation ceremony — A prophetic foreshadowing of Jesus declaring:
📖 John 7:37
“If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.”
🐑 CONTRAST: DECEMBER 25 AND PAGAN FIRE
Tied to sun god worship (Sol Invictus)
Associated with Saturnalia — a Roman festival filled with immorality, drunkenness, and mockery
No scriptural or prophetic alignment
🔥 The light of the world was not born during a festival of false lights.

💥 PROPHETIC VERDICT:
Jesus was born on God’s clock, not Rome’s calendar.
His birth fulfilled tabernacle prophecy, not tradition pollution.

GLOBAL IMPACT — HOW MISDATING JESUS’ BIRTH AFFECTS US TODAY
🌍 SYSTEM SCAN: CULTURAL WARFARE DETECTED | TRUTH RECON SEQUENCE INITIATED
🔥 This isn’t just about a date — it’s about distortion that leads to deception.
🎯 WHY DOES IT MATTER?
Many say,
“It doesn’t matter when He was born — what matters is that He was born.”
But that statement ignores two fatal issues:
Truth matters to God — especially in what we teach, preach, and celebrate.
If Satan can distort the beginning, he can deceive the direction.

🧠 3 REASONS THE DECEMBER 25 TRADITION HARMS THE CHURCH:
❌ 1. It Blends Christ with Counterfeits
December 25 fuses Christ’s holy incarnation with pagan holidays like Saturnalia, Sol Invictus, and Yule.
“What communion hath light with darkness?” (2 Corinthians 6:14)
🎄 From mistletoe (a Druid fertility symbol) to tree worship (Jeremiah 10:1–5), much of “Christmas” is polluted by idolatry.
❌ 2. It Commercializes Christ

The focus shifts from the Gospel to gifts, sales, and sentimentality.
Jesus becomes a seasonal mascot, not a 24/7 King.
“This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.” (Mark 7:6)
🔥 Many know the nativity story — but not the message of the Cross.
❌ 3. It Conditions Christians to Love Comfort Over Truth

When believers say “It’s not a big deal,” they reveal desensitized consciences.
This opens the door to future deceptions, like one-world religion unity, false unity over true purity, and apostate compromise.
“Because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved…” (2 Thess. 2:10)
🌊 GLOBAL IMPACT SNAPSHOT:
Churches decorate, but don’t disciple.
Preachers perform plays, but don’t preach purity.
Millions embrace Jesus as a baby — but never surrender to Him as Judge.
🧬 GOSPEL WARRIOR VERDICT:

🔥 The issue is not whether you have a tree…
The issue is: Did the world rewire your worship?
🔥 The question is not whether you celebrate —
But who scripted what you're celebrating?

REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY — “WHEN I FOUND OUT THE TRUTH ABOUT DECEMBER 25”
🧬 TESTIMONY CHANNEL ACTIVE | FIRE-SEARED MEMORY SEQUENCE DEPLOYED
🔥 The moment the lie collapsed… the scroll was born.
👤 Testimony of Brother Elias “The Watchman” Cruz — Former Youth Pastor, Now Truth Reformer

"I used to be the loudest voice for December 25. I led plays. I wrote dramas. I wept over the manger.
But the day someone asked me, ‘Where in the Bible does it say He was born on that date?’…
…I had no answer.
That question became a wound — but a holy wound.

So I searched. I fasted. I wept. I read ancient sources, Scripture, Jewish feast timelines.
And I found out:
🎯 I had built a ministry around a myth.
I realized that if I could celebrate Christ with lies, then I could preach Him with compromise.

So I shut down our Christmas program.
We replaced the December 25 spotlight with a September Sukkot gospel revival.
We taught the people the mo’edim — the divine appointments of God.
And what happened?

🔥 Conviction fell.
🔥 Mixture broke.
🔥 Young people wept for truth, not tradition.
One of our teens said to me:
‘Pastor, I never knew Jesus was that exact. That prophetic. That powerful.’”

Now, I no longer say “Merry Christmas.”
I say: He was born at the Father’s time — not Rome’s schedule.
And I choose to celebrate **what is pure, what is written, what is prophetic — not what is popular.”

💥 VERDICT:
When you know better, you preach better.
When you discover truth, you disciple with fire.

FINAL CHALLENGE — SOUL-STRIKE CALL TO RENOUNCE MIXTURE AND RETURN TO DOCTRINAL FIRE
🩸 ALTAR ENGAGED | MIXTURE MUST DIE HERE
🔥 This is where traditions burn and truth resurrects.
💣 NO MORE EXCUSES

You’ve now heard the Scriptures.
You’ve seen the timeline.
You’ve read the testimony.
You know December 25 is not the birthday of Jesus.
So the real question is:

Will you keep repeating it…
Or will you repent for ever preaching it?
⚔️ HOLY FIRE VERDICT:

🎯 If you lead a ministry — cleanse your calendar.
🎯 If you’ve preached false dates — renounce them publicly.
🎯 If you’ve taught your children Christmas tradition — reteach them prophetic truth.
🎯 If you’ve posted “Happy Birthday Jesus” every December 25 — delete it and post truth instead.
📖 Ezekiel 44:23 (KJV)
“And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane…”

🧬 That’s your job now.
Not to stay silent — but to divide light from darkness.
Tradition from truth. Paganism from prophecy.
🔥 FINAL CHALLENGE:

💥 Will you stay bound to Rome’s date?
💥 Or return to Heaven’s timing?
💥 Will you stay in a storybook gospel?
💥 Or embrace the prophetic, blood-soaked, scripturally-precise Christ?

This is not about being different.
It’s about being accurate.

This is not about canceling Christmas.
It’s about cleansing the pulpit.

OOL’S VS. WISE RESPONSE — THE DIVIDE BETWEEN LOVERS OF TRADITION AND SEEKERS OF TRUTH
⚖️ DIVINE DIVISION INITIATED | FINAL LINE IN THE SAND
🔥 This is not a debate. This is a decision.
💡 THE WISE RESPONSE:

Those who carry the fire of truth, not the comfort of culture.
They say:

“If it’s not in Scripture, I don’t want it in my pulpit.”
“If the Father didn’t schedule it, I will not celebrate it.”
“If it leads souls to mixture, I will call it out with tears — not tolerance.”
“If it honors Jesus, it must be built on truth — not tradition baptized in nostalgia.”
📖 Proverbs 9:9 (KJV)
“Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser…”
🔥 The wise burn their golden calves — even if it costs them their Christmas productions.
💀 THE FOOLISH RESPONSE:

Those who defend tradition more than truth.
They say:

“It doesn’t matter.”
“It’s just a celebration.”
“We mean well.”
“You’re being too legalistic.”
But they forget…
📖 Mark 7:13 (KJV)
“Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition…”

🔥 The fool will preach mixture with passion — and mock the watchmen who cry out.
🔥 The fool chooses the crowd’s applause over the King’s correction.
🧬 VERDICT:

There is no middle ground.
Either you adjust your celebration to truth,
Or you force truth to fit your tradition — and become part of the deception.

WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? — ETERNAL ACCOUNTABILITY FOR PREACHING TRADITION AS TRUTH
🩸 JUDGMENT SCROLL OPENED | ETERNAL TRIAL INITIATED
🔥 It’s not just about how you celebrated Christ…
…it’s about whether He recognizes you at all.
💭 WHAT IF YOU STOOD BEFORE THE THRONE TONIGHT…
…and the King asked:

“Why did you preach a tradition I never gave you?”
“Why did you spread a date I never spoke?”
“Why did you honor Rome’s calendar while ignoring My appointed times?”
“Why did you decorate instead of discern?”
“Why did you hide in culture instead of heralding My truth?”
Would your answer be:

“But everyone else did…”
“It wasn’t a big deal…”
“I didn’t want to offend anyone…”

⚖️ On that Day, “everyone” won’t be standing next to you.
Only you.
You, your scrolls, your sermons, your Facebook posts, and your traditions.
And the Judge will not weigh them by emotion —
But by truth.
📖 Matthew 7:22–23 (KJV)
“Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord… and then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.”

🔥 The most terrifying words in eternity will not be spoken to atheists…
…but to those who used His name while twisting His truth.
🧬 GOSPEL WARRIOR VERDICT:

This scroll is not about December 25.
It’s about whether your altar is built on revelation or religion.
And if your doctrine cannot survive judgment…
…it was never truth to begin with.

SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS — HOW THE ENEMY USED DECEMBER 25 TO DISTRACT, DECEIVE, AND DEFILE THE CHURCH
🐍 DEMONIC STRATEGY EXPOSED | FIRE CODE BREACH IDENTIFIED
🔥 This wasn’t just a holiday… it was an infiltration.
🕷️ SNEAK ATTACK #1: REDIRECT WORSHIP TO A FALSE TIMELINE

Satan doesn’t always cancel worship — sometimes he just redirects it.
By establishing a false birthday, he redirected the Church’s focus, calendar, and rhythm away from biblical appointments.
Result: People sing about the Savior while celebrating in a season of deception.
🕷️ SNEAK ATTACK #2: INFECT HOLY INCARNATION WITH PAGANISM

By mixing tree worship (Jeremiah 10), sun god rituals (Sol Invictus), and Roman festivals (Saturnalia)…
…the enemy tainted the doctrine of Christ’s birth with unholy fire.

🔥 Mixture equals contamination.
🔥 Contamination kills discernment.
🔥 Lost discernment births deception.
🕷️ SNEAK ATTACK #3: CREATE A SENTIMENTAL JESUS INSTEAD OF THE SOVEREIGN LORD

December 25 pushes baby Jesus, not Lord Jesus.
The manger becomes the focus — not the Man, not the Cross, not the Blood, not the throne.
“A gospel that only preaches the cradle and never confronts with the crown is a seduction.”
🕷️ SNEAK ATTACK #4: NEUTRALIZE WATCHMEN WITH MOCKERY
When prophets or reformers speak out about December 25, they are mocked as:

“Grinches”
“Legalists”
“Religious fanatics”
This discredits the voice of warning and silences reformation in pulpits.
Isaiah 30:10 — “Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things…”
🕷️ SNEAK ATTACK #5: INFILTRATE THE NEXT GENERATION

Children grow up memorizing Santa songs, not Scripture scrolls.
They connect joy, light, and love to a counterfeit season, not to the Gospel of repentance and truth.
🔥 The enemy is playing the long game — and the Church must stop feeding him the platform.
🧬 GOSPEL WARRIOR COUNTERSTRIKE:
🔥 Remove mixture.
🔥 Restore mo’edim.
🔥 Reform pulpits.
🔥 Raise fireproof disciples.

GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — FULL ALTAR CALL TO RENOUNCE DECEMBER 25 AND SURRENDER TO BIBLICAL WORSHIP
🩸 ALTAR IGNITED | TOTAL SURRENDER REQUIRED
🔥 This isn’t about preferences — it’s about prophetic obedience.

“Lord Jesus, I come out of every lie I was taught.
I renounce the counterfeit calendar.
I renounce man-made traditions.

Forgive me for ever defending a lie in Your name.

🔥 I burn the altar of December 25.
🔥 I ignite the altar of holy truth.
🔥 I covenant now with the A.S.I.S. doctrine:
“Jesus, I declare: I am not saved by hype or history, but only by surrender. I submit fully to the A.S.I.S. Covenant.”

I receive Your blood.

In Jesus’ name. Amen.”
📜 🔥 A.S.I.S. CERTIFIED — Always Saved, If Surrendered

WARFARE ASSIGNMENT / DISCIPLESHIP CHARGE — 5 FIRE ORDERS TO CLEAN, CORRECT, AND COMMISSION
⚔️ GOSPEL MISSION DEPLOYMENT | STRATEGIC TARGETS ASSIGNED
